title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

15 hours ago
Impeachment trial not just about Sara, but Duterte branding – lawyer

Corona impeachment prosecutor and former congressman Niel Tupas Jr. on Monday, October 12, says that the impeachment trial of Sara Duterte is not just about the Vice President herself, but also the branding of the whole Duterte family.

blocks.text: Prosecution needed financial forensic analyst Cabrera to close case – lawyer

Constitutional lawyer and law professor Lulu Reyes says that the prosecution needed financial forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera to close its presentation in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment case on Monday, October 12.

Reyes says this in response to a question in a Rappler interview, noting that Cabrera’s testimony “was the confirmation and elaboration and amplification” of issues raised about Vice President Sara Duterte’s financial records.
Reyes says it became clearer that “the math is not math-ing” when it comes to the Vice President’s corporate interests, following Cabrera’s testimony.

blocks.text: 16 hours ago
Tolosa: No need to call Sara Duterte as witness since prosecution evidence sufficient

Prosecution legal spokesperson Jay Tolosa says the prosecution believes that the evidence it presented in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial is sufficient, prompting it to drop plans to call her as a witness. In an interview with Rappler, he says the senator-judges can decide the case based on the evidence presented by both sides.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Corona impeachment prosecutor: Unexplained wealth case most important in Sara Duterte trial

Corona impeachment prosecutor and former congressman Niel Tupas Jr. says that the second article of impeachment related to Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth is the “battleground” article and is the most crucial among all allegations.

“The burden has already shifted to the defense. It is now up to the defense to present its evidence,” Tupas says Monday, October 12, as the impeachment court dismissed the prosecution’s final witness, forensic financial analyst Alexander Cabrera.

blocks.text: 18 hours ago
Impeachment court targets November 9 for defense presentation of evidence
The defense panel of Vice President Sara Duterte will start the presentation of their evidence in her impeachment trial on November 9, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said Monday, October 12.
The prosecution finishes its presentation of evidence on October 12, with forensic financial analyst and lawyer Alex Cabrera as its last witness.

blocks.text: Sara Duterte’s unexplained wealth could go as high as P1.5B – financial forensic analyst
Financial forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera says the undeclared wealth of Vice President Sara Duterte from 2022 to 2025 could reach P1.5 billon if his estimates are not “conservative.”
Cabrera previously said that based on his findings, Duterte’s unexplained wealth may be at P817 million.
